asset_heavy.reason: Cloud software platform (hStream) sold as SaaS; needs little physical plant or fleet investment.

big_ticket.reason: Annual SaaS subscriptions for learning, credentialing and scheduling are routine, not large infrequent purchases.

cyclical_demand.reason: Compliance training, credentialing and workforce tools are needed for regulatory readiness in healthcare, so hard to cut.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are hospitals and health systems, which are large organizations; also health plans.

notes: Customer size is judged from hospitals and health systems; it also serves smaller facilities.

offers_products.reason: Sells SaaS software: hStream platform, Learning Center LMS, credentialing and scheduling applications.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from software subscriptions; any implementation or support is incidental to the platform.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for the software platform and content, not for staff time.

recurring_revenue.reason: SaaS subscriptions to learning, credentialing and scheduling platforms renew on an ongoing basis.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells to healthcare organizations; clinicians use it through their employers, who choose and buy it.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Buyers are hospitals, health systems, long-term care facilities, ambulatory practices, EMS and health plans.
